extraFacts.fact: Wave 4 products are API certified and supplied with the API monogram by API-licensed manufacturers to the applicable specification: API 6A, API 16A, API 16C, API 16D or API 7K.

faqs.q: What is a 1,500 cu.ft. L-frame cement silo with load cells used for?
faqs.a: A cement silo is bulk storage for cement on an oilfield cementing spread. This cylindrical silo has a nominal capacity of 1,500 cu.ft. on an L-shaped frame for horizontal transport and vertical site installation, with aeration nozzles and a load-cell weighing system.

faqs.q: What capacities does the cement silo range offer besides 1,500 cu.ft.?
faqs.a: Alternative capacities of 1,200 cu.ft. and 1,900 cu.ft. are available, plus custom sizes. This listing is the 1,500 cu.ft. size, so state the storage volume you need on the RFQ.

faqs.q: What does the L-frame on the 1,500 cu.ft. L-frame cement silo with load cells do?
faqs.a: The L-shaped frame lets the silo be transported horizontally and then installed vertically on site. State the transport route and the site foundation conditions on the RFQ.

faqs.q: How does the weighing system on the 1,500 cu.ft. L-frame cement silo with load cells work?
faqs.a: Load cells weigh the silo contents with a digital local display, an optional remote display, and integration with the cementing unit data acquisition system. State the display and integration you need on the RFQ.

faqs.q: How does the 1,500 cu.ft. L-frame cement silo with load cells discharge smoothly?
faqs.a: Aeration nozzles and an air manifold fluidise the cement for smooth discharge. The silo has fill, vent and discharge lines that support cluster interconnection with neighbouring silos.

faqs.q: What certifications can the 1,500 cu.ft. L-frame cement silo with load cells carry?
faqs.a: The listing offers CE and GOST certifications on request. State the approvals and any pressure-vessel code requirements on the RFQ.

faqs.q: What connects to the 1,500 cu.ft. L-frame cement silo with load cells?
faqs.a: Fill, vent and discharge lines connect to bulk trucks, the dust collector and the mixing system. See [dust collectors](/c/cementing-dust-collector), [rock catchers](/c/cementing-rock-catcher) and [cementing units](/c/cementing-units).

faqs.q: How does the 1,500 cu.ft. L-frame cement silo with load cells differ from a cutting bottle?
faqs.a: A silo stores bulk cement and discharges it by aeration, while a [cutting bottle](/p/cement-cutting-bottle-skid-mounted-4-blade-needle-pneumatic-top-valve) opens big bags into the system. Use silos for bulk jobs and a cutting bottle for bag-delivered cement.

faqs.q: Where is the 1,500 cu.ft. L-frame cement silo with load cells used?
faqs.a: It is used for bulk cement storage on cementing spreads, in clusters of interconnected silos for larger jobs. See the guide on [cementing and drilling-fluid equipment](/blog/cementing-and-drilling-fluid-equipment) for the whole spread.

faqs.q: How should a cement silo be checked before a job?
faqs.a: Check the load-cell readings against a known weight, the aeration nozzles for blockage and the vent line and filter for clogging. State the inspection requirements on the RFQ if a third party must witness.

faqs.q: What should I send for a cement silo quotation?
faqs.a: Send the capacity (1,200, 1,500 or 1,900 cu.ft., or custom), the weighing display options, the number of silos to be clustered, the certification needed and the site conditions.

faqs.q: Does Indus stock the 1,500 cu.ft. L-frame cement silo with load cells?
faqs.a: Yes. We list the 1,500 cu.ft. L-frame cement silo with load cells as ex-stock from our warehouse in Dubai, UAE, and ship worldwide with the best lead times. Send your capacity, drive and mounting requirements through [our contact page](/contact) for a quotation.
